_comment: Tier-2 for sparta rarefied_flow:9 and :10, executed on the installed binary (SPARTA 24 Sep 2025, spa_serial). Twelve decks, all the same 1 mm 2d argon box, differing only in the compute lines. rarefied_flow:9 — 'compute property/grid all vol' with ONE attribute is a per-grid VECTOR: bare c_p reduces cleanly and bracketed c_p[1] aborts with 'ERROR: Compute reduce compute does not calculate a per-grid array (../compute_reduce.cpp:232)'; with TWO attributes it is an ARRAY and the two mistakes swap, the bare form now giving 'ERROR: Compute reduce compute does not calculate a per-grid vector (../compute_reduce.cpp:229)'. That is the reverse of 'compute grid', which is always an array and rejects the bare form even with a single value — run here as the control. property/grid also carries GEOMETRY ONLY: 'nrho' gives 'ERROR: Invalid keyword in compute property/grid command (../compute_property_grid.cpp:84)' and 'zc' in 2d gives 'ERROR: Invalid compute property/grid field for 2d simulation (../compute_property_grid.cpp:54)'. rarefied_flow:10 — 'compute ke/particle' named in stats_style gives 'ERROR: Stats compute does not compute scalar (../stats.cpp:678)' and works through 'compute reduce ave'; 'replace 1 1' gives 'ERROR: Illegal compute reduce command (../compute_reduce.cpp:168)'. NOTHING NUMERIC IS PINNED: the only value read is the summed cell volume, and it is checked against lx*lx computed from the deck's own create_box line, which is the 2d per-metre-depth identity, not a remembered number. COVERS: rarefied_flow:9, rarefied_flow:10. MUTATION CONTROL (T2_MUTATE=1, re-runnable): the ONE-attribute property/grid gains a second attribute — the single edit that removes the pathology under test — so it becomes an array and the bracket rule flips. Box, grid, seed, species, collide and run length are untouched. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES (rc=0); with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1) and these expect_in_output strings go False and disappear: one_attribute_is_a_vector=True, bracketing_a_one_attribute_property_grid_fails=True, the_two_shape_mistakes_have_opposite_messages=True. The geometry-only, compute-grid-control and reduce-bridge assertions run on decks the hook does not touch and stay True; each rests on a verbatim message carrying its own (file:line). Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/sparta/per_grid_shapes_and_the_reduce_bridge && python source.py (passes, rc=0), then T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py (fails, rc=1). Needs a SPARTA binary: the fixtures find spa_serial/spa_mpi on PATH or at ~/Schreibtisch/sparta/src/spa_serial, else set SPARTA_BINARY; with none present they exit 0 on a SKIP: line, which forbid_in_output turns into a failure. The decks, the evidence and the mutation control are unchanged.
